goal: Every dashboard chart states what it plots, in what unit, over what window — on screen and to a screen reader — without changing a single number it draws.
non_goals: Changing what any chart computes or how it buckets. The Review-time anchor and the KPI fragments are ADR 0019 / #688 / #757 and are OUT of this ticket entirely.
Adding tooltips as a substitute for a label — that is #1086's affordance and the wrong tool for a missing unit
A charting library. Every chart here is hand-built SVG and stays that way.
Redesigning the aggregate dashboard's card layout
user_visible_behavior: Each chart carries an accessible name and a short text description of what it plots.
Axes and units are labelled where a number is otherwise unitless.
The window a chart covers is stated on the chart, not only in surrounding copy.
Per-location and aggregate versions of the same chart describe themselves consistently.
invariants: No chart's data, bucketing or window arithmetic changes. src/lib/kpi/fragments.ts is untouched.
A per-location chart and its aggregate peer never disagree about what they claim to show.
Shared chart machinery stays shared — a change to chart-tokens or ChartTooltip is deliberate and named, never incidental.
CardViewTabs remains a view switch and keeps rendering on desktop.
edge_cases: Empty series: the chart must still say what it would have plotted.
A single data point, where a trend line has nothing to draw.
390px, where an axis label competes with the plot for width.
Reduced motion, where the entry animation is suppressed.
prefers-contrast / colour-blind readers, for charts that separate series by colour alone.
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/components/dashboard/kpi/ReputationTrendChart.tsx — the ONE chart that already carries an accessible name; the precedent to copy
src/components/dashboard/kpi/ChartHeadlineBanner.tsx + chart-headlines.ts — the existing way a chart states its own headline, and often the cheaper fix
src/components/dashboard/charts/chart-tokens.ts — the shared colour and scale tokens
tests_to_add: every dashboard chart exposes an accessible name
every dashboard chart states the window it covers
a chart with an empty series still says what it would plot
a per-location chart and its aggregate peer describe the same measure identically
no chart changes the values it plots
rollback_plan: Revert the squash commit. Presentation only; no data path, no migration, no flag.
